notes.title: RELEASE WINDOW TRAILER
notes.notes:
Today we are very happy to share another update on ROUTINE, along with a new trailer which we were lucky enough to debut this evening during Gamescom Opening Night Live.


[previewyoutube="hH5ZYM3nCP0;full"][/previewyoutube]


That’s right, ROUTINE will launch in late 2025 on Steam and Xbox platforms. It’s been a long ride, but we’re almost there. 



Thank you for being patient with us. We are still busy working on the game but we're excited to share more from the world of ROUTINE with you again soon. 



-Lunar Software

notes.title: Update - October 30, 2022
notes.notes:
There have been a few inquiries about the safety and well-being of the Lunar base's Independent Computers. We recently obtained footage showing that they are still in operation and appear very functional.

[previewyoutube=XmBQyYgdesE;full][/previewyoutube]

FAQ

• What engine are you using?


For the Re-reveal trailer we were still using Unreal Engine 4, but we have now made the switch to Unreal Engine 5.
• Who is working on Routine?


It's the same core team of 4 people, however, thanks to our publisher Raw Fury, we have been able to get extra help on the Art and Writing side of things.
• Will the game support 4:3 resolutions so we can enjoy it on our favourite CRT?


As huge fans of CRT's This is something we are already looking into but can't promise anything just yet.
• Is the trailer pre-rendered?


Everything in the trailer was realtime and in-engine. All first person sequences were actual gameplay.

We hope you all have a spooky Halloween and found some great titles during the Steam Scream event!

-Lunar Software
